notes.title: Update from 08.20.2016
notes.notes:
Update from 08.20.2016

- Items such as coins, arrows and potions now stack on the ground
- Potions and coins now also stack inside the chest, using up only one slot
- Fixed buying the sword from Idad on the Fair
- Implemented zoom option, up to 4x
